verse.text: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.

reflection.scripture: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord’s coming is near.
reflection.observation: James writes to believers enduring suffering and injustice, calling them to mirror the patience of a farmer waiting for rain — active endurance rooted in trust. 'Stand firm' means holding ground under pressure, not shrinking back. The promise that 'the Lord's coming is near' sparks hope, not anxiety. The wait has an end; the harvest is coming.
reflection.application: Identify one area where you're waiting on God — a prayer, a transition, a healing — and choose patience as an act of faith. Stand firm by showing up consistently: pray, do the next right thing, and trust the timing you can't see.
reflection.prayer: Lord, patience is hard when my heart wants answers now. Teach me to wait like a farmer waits for rain — with quiet confidence, not frantic worry. Help me stand firm in what You've called me to, even when the ground feels dry. Thank You that Your coming is near and my waiting is not wasted. Strengthen my heart today. Amen.
